text.equipment.weapon.work.pot_sling.name: Cooper's pot sling
text.equipment.weapon.work.pot_sling.descript: P selects a carried pitch, lime or brine pot; Enter casts at a place in sight three to six paces away. The burst can harm anyone nearby.
text.equipment.weapon.work.throwing_axe.name: Balanced throwing axe
text.equipment.weapon.work.throwing_axe.descr: Throws the readied axe where it strikes, leaving the weapon hand empty. It weakens timber support and must be recovered.
text.equipment.weapon.work.forked_pike.name: Forked ward pike
text.equipment.weapon.work.forked_pike.descri: Pins the target and one neighbour across its forward line, buying one turn against a pair. Adjacent foes are inside the forks.
text.equipment.weapon.work.war_flail.name: Jointed threshing flail
text.equipment.weapon.work.war_flail.descript: One exposed wind-up precedes a sweep through nearby foes. Moving abandons the wind-up; the wide head also harms a nearby convoy escort.
text.equipment.weapon.work.spade.name: Bank cutter's spade
text.equipment.weapon.work.spade.description: Cuts reeds and digs banks with F. A strike from dry soil or ash throws sight-obscuring dust; wet or stone footing gives no dust.
A clear, dry, same-level approach closes up to two paces under guard before a short cut. An encumbered load or injured leg cannot charge.
text.equipment.weapon.work.glaive.name: Coppice glaive
text.equipment.weapon.work.glaive.description: Keeps a two-pace minimum and clips one body beside the target. Close inside the blade or separate the line.
text.equipment.weapon.work.pollaxe.name: Quarry pollaxe
text.equipment.weapon.work.pollaxe.descriptio: The hammer and beak punish protectors, elites and machinery, and the back spike damages timber support.
text.equipment.weapon.work.arming_sword.name: Watch arming sword
text.equipment.weapon.work.arming_sword.descr: A measured cut leaves a guarded counter-posture while reducing the target's willingness to press.
text.equipment.weapon.work.long_knife.name: Smokehouse long knife
text.equipment.weapon.work.long_knife.descrip: A silent close cut interrupts a marked ranged aim. Its small edge is poor for force or reach.
text.equipment.weapon.work.boat_hook.name: Long-shafted boat hook
text.equipment.weapon.work.boat_hook.descript: Pulls a body one pace, or two from flooded ground, turning channels into a rescue or separation tool.
text.equipment.weapon.work.flanged_mace.name: Gatewatch flanged mace
text.equipment.weapon.work.flanged_mace.descr: A compact impact breaks three morale; distance and disciplined protection answer it.
text.equipment.weapon.work.estoc.name: Needle estoc
text.equipment.weapon.work.estoc.description: A narrow thrust gains two harm against protectors, elites and machinery but has no crowd control.
text.equipment.weapon.work.felling_axe.name: Charcoal felling axe
text.equipment.weapon.work.felling_axe.descri: A loud close cut strips two measures of support from struck timber, opening routes or risking collapse.
text.equipment.weapon.work.quarterstaff.name: Ferruled quarterstaff
text.equipment.weapon.work.quarterstaff.descr: Drives a target back and leaves a guarded stance, trading harm for space and safety.
text.equipment.weapon.work.reed_sickle.name: Fen reed sickle
text.equipment.weapon.work.reed_sickle.descri: Cuts reeds beneath a target into loose dry fuel and shakes animals; fire can exploit what remains.
text.equipment.weapon.work.anchor_fluke.name: Shingle anchor fluke
text.equipment.weapon.work.anchor_fluke.descr: Pulls a target while flooded footing anchors the courier in guard. Weight and noise are its costs.
text.equipment.weapon.work.chain_hook.name: Cut-chain hook
text.equipment.weapon.work.chain_hook.descrip: Entangles at reach for no direct harm; the target spends its next action cutting free.
text.equipment.weapon.arsenal.watch_sap.name: Watch Sap
text.equipment.weapon.arsenal.ore_pick.name: Ore Pick
text.equipment.fitting.iron_heel.name: Iron heel
text.equipment.fitting.iron_heel.effect: Allows F brace, lever and break with the readied shaft; successful work wears the heel.
text.equipment.fitting.iron_heel.drawback: Heavy; levering makes two extra noise.
text.equipment.fitting.quiet_binding.name: Quiet binding
text.equipment.fitting.quiet_binding.effect: Cuts committed attack sound by two; each attack wears its felt.
text.equipment.fitting.quiet_binding.drawback: Cannot share the structural socket with a heel or retrieval cord.
text.equipment.fitting.retrieval_cord.name: Retrieval cord
text.equipment.fitting.retrieval_cord.effect: Leaves a spent shaft or net as a physical recoverable item; nearby casts reel back if the pack fits.
text.equipment.fitting.retrieval_cord.drawbac: Casting range falls by two; ten committed throws wear out the cord.
text.equipment.fitting.resin_seal.name: Resin seal
text.equipment.fitting.resin_seal.effect: A sealed string keeps its prepared shot in rain; wet shots wear the treatment.
text.equipment.fitting.resin_seal.drawback: Stiff string costs one range; resin accelerates fire damage to the weapon.
text.equipment.fitting.ash_wrap.name: Ash wrap
text.equipment.fitting.ash_wrap.effect: A shot made from smoke retains range despite smoke inhalation; firing from smoke wears the wrap.
text.equipment.fitting.ash_wrap.drawback: Only the inhalation penalty is relieved: thick smoke still blocks line of fire.
text.equipment.fitting.wool_lining.name: Wool lining
text.equipment.fitting.wool_lining.drawback: Absorbent wool adds four wet weight as well as its dry weight.
text.equipment.fitting.reed_lining.name: Reed lining
text.equipment.fitting.reed_lining.effect: Sheds bog mud and gives a usable stance in deep current.
text.equipment.fitting.reed_lining.drawback: The bulky liner opens a pierce-protection gap at the fitted location.
text.equipment.fitting.iron_scales.name: Iron scales
text.equipment.fitting.iron_scales.effect: Adds local pierce protection and closes a coverage gap.
text.equipment.fitting.iron_scales.drawback: One extra noise and mobility burden; no second lining fits.
text.equipment.pot.invalid_range: The pot sling needs a visible landing three to {reach} paces away.
text.equipment.pot.missing: That physical pot is not in the pack; nothing was thrown.
text.equipment.pot.no_cell: The landing has no usable material space; the pot stays packed.
text.equipment.pot.pitch.wet: The pitch pot wets the landing with fuel; existing water denies ignition.
text.equipment.pot.pitch.dry: The pitch pot wets the landing with fuel; fire can spread downwind into dry material.
text.equipment.pot.lime: The lime pot raises an abrasive cloud; water sustains its caustic slurry.
text.equipment.pot.brine: The brine pot quenches the landing; salt water follows openings and burdens exposed bodies.
text.equipment.pot.fitting: {fitting}; the pot still breaks loudly at its landing.
text.equipment.approach.load: A shielded approach needs a manageable load and sound legs and feet.
text.equipment.approach.level: The shield cannot charge through a different floor.
text.equipment.approach.blocked: Water, broken footing or another body blocks the shielded approach.
text.equipment.approach.wet: Wet or frozen material denies a shielded charge.
text.equipment.strike.war_flail: the exposed wind-up sweeps {count} other nearby bodies
text.equipment.strike.spade.dust: dry bank dust obscures the struck place and changes the next pursuit
text.equipment.strike.spade.none: wet or stone footing gives no dust to throw
text.equipment.strike.throwing_axe.timber: the lodged axe weakens timber before falling where it struck
text.equipment.strike.throwing_axe.ground: the actual axe falls where it struck; the weapon hand is left empty
text.equipment.strike.shield_hanger: the shielded approach trades damage for closing the lane
text.equipment.strike.glaive.clip: the long edge clips {target} beside the target
text.equipment.strike.glaive.none: the long edge finds no second body
text.equipment.strike.arming_sword: the measured cut closes in a guarded counter-posture
text.equipment.strike.long_knife.interrupt: the silent cut spoils the marked aim
text.equipment.strike.long_knife.normal: the small blade lands without a report
text.equipment.strike.boat_hook: the hook hauls the target {moved} pace{suffix}
text.equipment.strike.estoc.armoured: the narrow point enters a rigid gap
text.equipment.strike.estoc.unarmoured: the narrow point finds no rigid gap
text.equipment.strike.felling_axe.cut: the broad edge removes two timber support
text.equipment.strike.felling_axe.none: the broad edge finds no timber support
text.equipment.strike.quarterstaff: the ferrule drives the target back under guard
text.equipment.strike.reed_sickle.cut: cut reeds fall as loose dry fuel
text.equipment.strike.reed_sickle.none: the sickle finds no reeds to turn into fuel
text.equipment.strike.anchor_fluke.anchored: flooded footing anchors the pull and leaves guard
text.equipment.strike.anchor_fluke.normal: the heavy fluke drags the target inward
text.equipment.strike.chain_hook: the chain entangles without direct harm
text.equipment.arsenal.device.range: Choose a visible landing within this device's throwing reach.
text.equipment.arsenal.device.cell: That landing cannot hold a material reaction.
text.equipment.arsenal.device.material_budget: The warned mineral flash needs room for two more measures of reagent.
text.equipment.arsenal.ammunition.none: No physical {ammunition} remain in the pack.
text.equipment.arsenal.device.result: {courier} throws one {ammunition} onto {x},{y}; {effect} changes the shared ground.{warning} {sound}
text.equipment.arsenal.device.warning: A mineral flash is warned for the next action.
text.equipment.arsenal.no_target: No legal visible hostile is within this weapon's reach.
text.equipment.arsenal.gun.loading: {weapon} needs {remaining} guarded loading action(s); press G.
text.equipment.arsenal.aim.prepare: {courier} prepares {weapon} on {target}; firing commits the next action.
text.equipment.arsenal.aim.gun_weather: Wet weather spoils the exposed gun aim before the charge is released.
text.equipment.arsenal.aim.bow_weather: Wet weather spoils the drawn bow string before the arrow is released.
text.equipment.workshop.compatible: Choose a compatible worn or readied item.
text.equipment.workshop.stock_empty: No physical kit or counted workshop stock remains.
text.equipment.workshop.credit: Need {cost} credit for the kit and bench work.
text.equipment.workshop.ready: Two actions; fitted mass still counts.
text.equipment.workshop.install.location: Approach the lower workshop with a known fitting.
text.equipment.workshop.install.result: The workshop fits {fitting} to {item}; {cost} credit and two actions. {effect}
text.equipment.workshop.remove.location: Approach the workshop with the equipped parent item.
text.equipment.workshop.remove.requirements: Removal needs a fitted part and one credit.
text.equipment.workshop.remove.pack: The removed part does not fit. Repack first; nothing changed.
text.equipment.workshop.remove.result: Removed {fitting} intact into the pack; one credit and two actions.
text.equipment.workshop.buy.location: Buy counted kits at the lower workshop.
text.equipment.workshop.buy.pack: The kit stays at the bench: no pack space. No stock or credit spent.
text.equipment.workshop.buy.result: Bought a physical {fitting} kit for {cost} credit; two actions of counted work.
text.equipment.workshop.repair.invalid: Choose damaged worn or readied equipment at the workshop.
text.equipment.workshop.repair.credit: Repair needs two credit for material and two actions.
text.equipment.workshop.repair.result: Repair work brings {item} to {condition} condition; two credit, two actions. Fitting wear remains separate.
text.equipment.workshop.describe.guidance: Fittings follow the parent through drops, theft and death; removal needs pack room.
text.equipment.fitting.quiet_binding: quiet binding muffles the committed attack
text.equipment.fitting.resin_seal: resin seal keeps the wet string prepared
text.equipment.fitting.ash_wrap: ash wrap steadies the smoky preparation
text.equipment.fitting.retrieval.recovered: retrieval cord reels the physical throw back into the pack
text.equipment.fitting.retrieval.ground: the tethered throw remains on the ground for physical recovery
text.equipment.enemy.recover.result: The {threat} {intent}; that exact weapon is no longer on the ground.
text.equipment.target.pot: P changes pot; minimum range 3. Enter throws at the marked place.
text.equipment.target.device: Enter throws one physical {bomb} bomb at this visible place; all bodies share its reaction.
text.equipment.target.gun_loading: Unready: Escape then G loads one guarded action.
text.equipment.target.aim.prepare: Enter prepares aim; confirm again to fire.
text.equipment.overlay.station.title: LOWER WORKSHOP — OPTIONAL FITTINGS
text.equipment.overlay.station.summary: Credit {credit}. Choose worn/readied equipment or a loose kit.
text.equipment.overlay.station.guidance: One structural fitting plus one treatment per weapon; one lining per armour piece.
text.equipment.overlay.store.title: COUNTED WORKSHOP KITS
text.equipment.overlay.store.summary: Preview before buying. Kits occupy the pack until fitted.
text.equipment.overlay.buy.title: BUY KIT — CONFIRM
text.equipment.overlay.fit.title: FIT EQUIPMENT — CONFIRM
text.equipment.overlay.confirm.title: EQUIPMENT WORK — CONFIRM
text.equipment.overlay.confirm.guidance: Removal keeps the part if it fits. Repair leaves fitting wear unchanged.
text.equipment.overlay.confirm.costs: Removal costs one credit; repair costs two. Both take two actions.
text.equipment.arsenal.bomb.description: One thrown payload; reacts at its landing.
text.intent.pinned.fork_line: pinned across the forked guard line
text.intent.disrupted.long_knife: its marked aim was spoiled by a silent close cut

text.intent.dazed.lime: eyes stung by the lime cloud

text.intent.entangled.equipment_bind: bound by a committed strike; loses a turn breaking free
text.intent.recovery.weapon_broken: its physical weapon has broken; seeks another or withdraws
